step_by_step_approach: Collect all words from the dataset.
Retain only words whose length is 4 or 5 characters.
Retain only words that start with the lower‑case letter 'r', respecting case.
Group words by the exact multiset of their characters (case‑sensitive) to identify anagram families.
Select words whose group contains more than one member, indicating at least one same‑length anagram.
Count the number of other words in each selected word's anagram group.
Take the first ten words from the sorted list.
Present each of these words together with its anagram count.
